text:
Situation: Oxytocin has been on FDA's shortage list since 2022-09-23 and as of 2026-10-21 the shortage has been listed for 49 months. Current inventory at Corvale East is 81 vials at 6.8 vials per day (11.9 days on hand) and at Corvale General is 113 vials at 8.7 vials per day (13 days on hand). Detailed stock: Corvale East SDV 55 on hand (16.5 days), MDV 26 on hand (7.6 days); Corvale General 53 on hand (11.7 days) and 60 on hand (14.3 days).

Why (FDA record): A registered plant for Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 1450022) was inspected and classified OAI on 2022-06-30, which was 85 days before FDA posted the shortage on 2022-09-23. The same plant received an OAI classification letter dated 2024-04-30, 585 days after the shortage posting. Another registered plant for Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (FEI 3001833549) has a history of OAI inspections in 2011-07-08 and 2013-01-11, with a Warning Letter issued 2012-02-22.

Our position: Supply is critically low at both campuses. The preferred alternative per protocol is oxytocin 10 units/mL from Par Health USA, LLC (manufactured at PH HEALTH), approved by Sam Rivera, MD on 2026-04-16, requiring dose recalculation and pharmacist verification.

Recommended actions:
1. Activate Par Health USA, LLC oxytocin 10 units/mL as primary alternative; requires pharmacist verification and dose recalculation. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
2. Qualify Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC OXYTOCIN 10 USP units/mL as secondary alternative; requires pharmacist verification and dose recalculation. Approval: Pharmacy Director.
3. Evaluate West-Ward Pharmaceuticals Corp product for purchase; not on FDA shortage list today, label names no identifiable plant. Approval: Buyer and Pharmacy Director.

Not recommended: No additional alternatives at this time.
